Aleksandar Pavlovic.summary: Aleksandar Pavlović is a Germany defensive midfielder from Bayern Munich who gives the national team press resistance, calm distribution, and midfield screening.
Aleksandar Pavlovic.note: Watch Pavlović for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Aleksandar Pavlovic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Alexander Nübel.note: Nübel stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Alexander Nübel.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会直塞球越过后防时及时出击。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Angelo Stiller.note: Stiller's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Angelo Stiller.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Antonio Rüdiger.note: Watch Rüdiger for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Antonio Rüdiger.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Assan Ouedraogo.note: Ouédraogo's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Assan Ouedraogo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

David Raum.note: Raum stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
David Raum.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Deniz Undav.note: Undav is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Deniz Undav.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Felix Nmecha.note: Nmecha stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Felix Nmecha.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Florian Wirtz.note: Wirtz stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Florian Wirtz.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Jamal Musiala.note: Musiala is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Jamal Musiala.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Jamie Leweling.note: Leweling stands out for carrying momentum through open midfield. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Jamie Leweling.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Jonathan Tah.note: Tah stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jonathan Tah.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Joshua Kimmich.note: Kimmich's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Joshua Kimmich.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Kai Havertz.note: Watch Havertz for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Kai Havertz.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Leon Goretzka.note: Goretzka stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Leon Goretzka.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Leroy Sane.note: Sané's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Leroy Sane.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Malick Thiaw.note: Thiaw's edge is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Malick Thiaw.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Manuel Neuer.note: Neuer stands out for starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Manuel Neuer.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用靠前站位保护后防身后空间。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Maximilian Beier.note: Beier's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Maximilian Beier.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Nadiem Amiri.note: Watch Amiri for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Nadiem Amiri.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Nathaniel Brown.note: Brown is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Nathaniel Brown.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Nick Woltemade.note: Woltemade's edge is making the next teammate's action easier. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Nick Woltemade.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Nico Schlotterbeck.note: Watch Schlotterbeck for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Nico Schlotterbeck.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Oliver Baumann.note: Baumann stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Oliver Baumann.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Pascal Groß.summary: Pascal Groß is a Germany central midfielder from Brighton & Hove Albion who adds passing range, set-piece quality, and veteran control.
Pascal Groß.note: Watch Groß for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Pascal Groß.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Waldemar Anton.note: Watch Anton for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Waldemar Anton.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。
